fields.name: Activity Arrival
fields.description: Patient's ability to move their extremities upon arrival for the appointment.
possible_values: Able to move 4 extremities: voluntarily or on command
Able to move 2 extremities: voluntarily or on command
Able to move 0 extremities: voluntarily or on command

fields.name: Activity Discharge
fields.description: Patient's ability to move their extremities upon discharge from the appointment.
possible_values: Able to move 4 extremities: voluntarily or on command
Able to move 2 extremities: voluntarily or on command
Able to move 0 extremities: voluntarily or on command

fields.name: Respiration Discharge
fields.description: Patient's ability to breathe upon discharge from the appointment.
possible_values: Able to cough and breathe deeply

fields.name: Circulation Discharge
fields.description: The patient's systolic blood pressure relative to their pre-anesthetic BP.
possible_values: systolic BP +/- 20 mm/hg of pre-anesthetic BP
systolic BP +/- 21-49 mm/hg of pre-anesthetic BP
systolic BP +/- 50 mm/hg of pre-anesthetic BP
